title: Discrete FEM-BEM coupling with the Generalized Optimized Schwarz Method
summary: The present contribution aims at developing a non-overlapping Domain Decomposition (DD) approach to the solution of acoustic wave propagation boundary value problems based on the Helmholtz equation, on both bounded and unbounded domains. This DD solver, called Generalized Optimized Schwarz Method (GOSM), is a substructuring method, that is, the unknowns of an iteration are associated with the subdomains interfaces.
